name: Kneeling Lat Stretch
steps: Start on hands and knees and slide one hand forward and slightly across your body.
Sit your hips smoothly back toward your heels while letting your chest sink gently toward the floor.
Let your ribs move away from the reaching hand until you feel a stretch along that side of your back.
Hold the stretch calmly with slow breaths on one side, then return upright and switch arms.
tips: Breathe deeply into the stretched side of your rib cage to help the lat relax.
Keep your neck relaxed rather than straining to look forward.
